additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480703-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / S4 170003481] OCPP internet connection problem CRM:03289000649
additional_info.body:
Hi Fosco,
This issue does not occur very frequently; however, from time to time the OCPP connection drops. When we reboot the charger, the connection is restored.
At this stage, we suspect that the issue might be related to the router.
Regarding the information you requested:
Symptoms:
OCPP connection is occasionally lost and is restored after rebooting the charger.
Actions performed:
The charger was rebooted and the connection came back online.
Current status:
Today at 14:00 (TR time), the connection dropped as shown below and I performed a reboot. You may check the logs around this timestamp for further analysis.
With best regards,
Yunus Emre Temel
